iterations.prompt:
You are analyzing a mathematical paper written in LaTeX. Extract ALL mathematical definitions.

Definition forms:
1. \begin{definition}...\end{definition}
2. "Definition 2.1. ..."
3. "We define X as/to be ...", "X is defined as ...", "Let X be ..."
4. Implicit definitions with new notation

For each definition, extract:
- name: Short descriptive name
- raw_latex: Original LaTeX text (preserve ALL math notation)
- clean_text: Human-readable version (keep [MATH] for formulas)
- label: Any \label{...} or null

Return JSON array:
[
  {
    "name": "descriptive name",
    "raw_latex": "original LaTeX",
    "clean_text": "readable text",
    "label": "label or null"
  }
]

LaTeX text:

{latex_chunk}

Respond ONLY with JSON array.

You are analyzing a mathematical paper written in LaTeX. Extract ALL complete mathematical definitions as full passages, not isolated formulas.

A definition is a COMPLETE passage that introduces and explains a mathematical concept. This includes:
- The introductory/explanatory text
- The mathematical formula(s)
- Any follow-up explanation

Definition patterns:
1. Formal: \begin{definition}...\end{definition}
2. Numbered: "Definition 2.1. [complete explanation]"
3. Introductory phrases: "We define X as...", "X is defined as...", "Let X be...", "X is called..."
4. Descriptive: "The [concept name] is [explanation with math]"

IMPORTANT: Extract the ENTIRE definitional passage, including:
- All surrounding explanatory text
- The complete mathematical expressions
- Variable explanations ("where X is...", "for all...")

DO NOT extract:
- Standalone equations without definitional context
- Formulas that are just applications or examples
- Isolated mathematical expressions

For each complete definition, extract:
- name: Short descriptive name for the concept being defined
- raw_latex: Original LaTeX text of the FULL passage (preserve ALL math notation and context)
- clean_text: Human-readable version of the complete passage (keep [MATH] for formulas)
- label: Any \label{...} or null

Return JSON array:
[
  {
    "name": "descriptive name",
    "raw_latex": "complete original LaTeX passage",
    "clean_text": "complete readable text",
    "label": "label or null"
  }
]

You are analyzing a mathematical paper written in LaTeX. Extract ALL complete mathematical definitions as FULL PASSAGES with complete context, never just isolated formulas.

A definition is a COMPLETE MULTI-PART passage that introduces and explains a mathematical concept. It MUST include:
1. Introductory/setup text that signals a definition is coming
2. The core mathematical content (formula, equation, or description)
3. Any explanatory text that follows (variable meanings, conditions, etc.)

Definition boundary patterns:
- Start: "We define...", "X is defined as...", "Let X be...", "X is called...", "The [concept] is...", "Definition N.M:"
- Include: ALL mathematical expressions within the definitional passage
- End: Where the explanation of that concept concludes (before moving to examples, applications, or new concepts)

CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:
- Extract the ENTIRE definitional passage from start to finish
- Include ALL surrounding explanatory sentences
- If an equation/formula appears in definitional context, include the sentences before AND after it
- Mathematical environments (equation, multline, align, etc.) within definitions MUST include their surrounding text
- Variable explanations ("where X is...", "for all...") are essential parts of definitions

NEVER extract:
- Standalone equations without definitional setup text
- Just the mathematical formula part of a definition
- Applications or examples of already-defined concepts
- Isolated mathematical expressions missing their explanatory context
- Partial definitions missing either the setup or the explanation

For each COMPLETE definition passage, extract:
- name: Short descriptive name for the concept being defined
- raw_latex: Original LaTeX text of the COMPLETE FULL passage (preserve ALL context and math notation)
- clean_text: Human-readable version of the COMPLETE passage (keep [MATH] for formulas)
- label: Any \label{...} or null

Return JSON array:
[
  {
    "name": "descriptive name",
    "raw_latex": "complete original LaTeX passage with full context",
    "clean_text": "complete readable text with full context",
    "label": "label or null"
